# 2 Baruch Chapter 57 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**57:1** "And-after-these-things of-which-I-have-spoken-to-you, the-first-bright-waters which-you-saw came, which-are-the-fountain-of-Abraham, and-his-generation, and-the-coming-of-his-son, and-his-son's-son, and-of-all-those-like-them."

**57:2** "For-at-that-time the-unwritten-law was-in-force among-them, and-the-works-of-the-commandments-were-then-accomplished, and-the-belief-in-the-coming-judgment-was-then-brought-into-being, and-the-hope-of-the-world-that-was-to-be-renewed-was-then-built-up in-their-hearts, and-the-promise-of-the-life-that-was-to-come-afterwards was-in-those-times planted-in-the-hearts-of-the-people."

**57:3** "These are-the-first-bright-waters which-have-been-shown-to-you."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
